app.set.aboutText: Kubrai runs parimutuel pools on the numbers of the apps in the Solana dApp Store (fees, revenue, volume, staking) and the Seeker itself. Every market settles from hourly snapshots whose hash is on-chain, the winning range is derived on-chain from the observed value, and payouts are pushed to your wallet automatically after a 6 h dispute window. Every time in the app is shown in your own time zone.
